name: create product via API (uid supplied by client)
query: mutation { createProducts(input: [{ uid: "hu:product:rt-0001", name: "Roundtrip Product", entityType: "Product", privacyClass: PUBLIC }]) { products { id uid name createdAt privacyClass } } }

name: read product back with DateTime (needs APOC)
query: { products(where: { uid: { eq: "hu:product:rt-0001" } }) { id uid name createdAt updatedAt } }

name: update attempt on uid (should be rejected if settable rules apply, else succeed)
query: mutation { updateProducts(where: { uid: { eq: "hu:product:rt-0001" } }, update: { name: { set: "Renamed" } }) { products { uid name } } }

name: read Cypher-ingested assertion (created below by driver) through generic Assertion type
query: { assertions(where: { uid: { eq: "hu:assertion:rt-0001" } }) { uid predicate status recordedAt polarity } }

name: enum rejection: invalid status value
query: mutation { createProducts(input: [{ uid: "hu:product:rt-0002", name: "X", entityType: "Product", privacyClass: SECRET }]) { products { uid } } }

name: read Document created by Cypher with stored names (alias check)
query: { documents(where: { uid: { eq: "hu:document:rt-0001" } }) { id uid name sourceUrl documentType } }
